verdict.rationale: Publishing a robots.txt is a fair question for any public web service, including IRCC's canada.ca pages, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack covers only service content (work permits, Start-up Visa, processing times) and never mentions a robots.txt or any crawler-access policy.

support.subject: As an AI-native founder, the service publishes a real robots.txt, so an agent can know what it may read before fetching anything
